name: windtunnel
description: The configuration this software package requires. Values are raw register contents, so a 30.0 s ramp is 300.
_source: PLAYBOOK.md phase 6, plus what the drive was observed running on 2026-08-19 to 08-22.
_warning: Group 53, 3018/3019 and group 99 are listed for the record and for `diff`. The PMC firmware REFUSES to write them at any time — group 53 is the serial config of the link the command arrives on, 3018/3019 is the comm-loss watchdog, group 99 is the motor model. Set those from the keypad, deliberately.

5304.why: 8E1 even parity, matches the PMC (keypad only)

1105.why: REF1 MAX = 2435 rpm. THE number: misread, every commanded speed is wrong by that ratio
